lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 5 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible across the mid and posterior torso, spaced at irregular intervals ranging from approximately 150 to 200 pixels.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments exhibit dashed or abbreviated topology; specifically, the second and third lines from the shoulder terminate approximately mid-flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; two primary high-contrast spots are visible on the lateral surface of the upper hind limb/haunch region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral-lyrate curvature; the horns initiate with a posterior-dorsal vector from the frontal bone before flaring laterally and curving inward towards the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximately 3.2:1 ratio of the distance between terminal tips compared to the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 15-20% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest of hair along the spinal ridge and distinctive tan-to-orange pigmentation on the distal leg segments starting below the knee and hock.
